title: Club-based player search returns empty for Brazilian clubs (FIFA 19 data limitation)
evidence: src/main/java/com/brsoccer/mcp/tools/McpTools.java:82 tool description states 'the dataset is FIFA 19, which contains no Brazilian-league clubs, so club searches for e.g. Flamengo return no players' — the club filter in QueryService.searchPlayers (query/QueryService.java:186) works correctly but the provided fifa_data.csv has no Brazilian clubs
suggestion: None required — the filter is correctly implemented and the data limitation is honestly disclosed in the tool description; noted for cross-run comparison only
